name: Cat-Cow with T-Spine Rotation
instructions: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale: drop the belly, lift the chest and tailbone (cow). Exhale: round the spine, tuck chin and pelvis (cat).
After several cycles, thread one arm under your body, rotating through the mid-back.
Return and open the same arm to the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes. Alternate sides.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Cat-Cow with T-Spine Rotation is a beginner mobility exercise for the upper back, performed with just your bodyweight. Regular mobility work keeps joints moving freely and makes strength training safer.
